title: Feature Ideas: TOTP / Resume Playback
body:
Hello 👋 Thanks for this project, seems like it has a lot of potential - and a dedicated dev (or team) 😊

Something I miss from all other selfhosted file browsers is a resume playback option, i.e. that a video can be continued where one left off (perfect as a self hosted learning platform).

Also, it would be great to see multi factor authentication implemented, i.e. TOTP. Security wise, IMHO, this is required if the app is exposed to the internet. 

Last, but not least, a sharing function would be great to allow others to view specific files / folders.

Just some ideas 🫡
author: d4rkw1n9

## Changelog

- **Updated Modal Close Behavior**
  - Modified the `closeModal` function to pause video and audio elements without resetting the video’s `currentTime` to 0. This ensures that saved progress in the video is preserved when the modal is closed.

- **Implemented Video Progress Saving and Resuming**
  - Added a unique key generation (using the file URL) to store the video’s playback progress in `localStorage`.
  - Attached a `loadedmetadata` event listener to the video element that checks for and restores any saved playback position.
  - Attached a `timeupdate` event listener to continuously update the saved progress in `localStorage` as the video plays.
  - Added an `ended` event listener to clear the saved progress when the video finishes playing.

@d4rkw1n9 progress saving and resume was added.

Closing as both features were added. Thanks for the suggestions.

File sharing already exists. Folder sharing is planned.
